content.short: Whalemap provides precise, actionable blockchain analytics and data.
content.description: Whalemap is a blockchain analytics platform that uses data science to deliver real-time, actionable trading insights by analyzing the behavior of large market participants. The goal is to illuminate data and signals that were historically available only to hedge funds, while keeping the information clear, accessible, and easy to understand. Whalemap's native token, $WMP, is used to access the platform's data and analytics, enabling users to explore market dynamics, monitor major players, and make more informed crypto trading decisions.
